gloss: stone material; building stone; masonry material

definitions.gloss: stone material; building stone; masonry material
definitions.explanation: Natural stone that has been quarried and processed for use in construction, decoration, or other applications.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{石材|せきざい}を{敷|し}いた。
examples.english: I laid stone in the garden.

examples.japanese: この{城|しろ}は{地元|じもと}の{石材|せきざい}で{造|つく}られている。
examples.english: This castle was built with local stone.

examples.japanese: {大理石|だいりせき}や{花崗岩|かこうがん}など、さまざまな{石材|せきざい}がキッチンのカウンターに{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Various stone materials such as marble and granite are used for kitchen counters.

notes:
Composed of {石|せき} (stone) + {材|ざい} (material). Used in construction, architecture, landscaping, and interior design contexts. Japan has a long tradition of stone masonry, particularly in castle walls ({石垣|いしがき}) and garden design.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石材|せきざい}{店|てん} — stone dealer, stone yard
- {石材|せきざい}を{加工|かこう}する — process/work stone
- {天然|てんねん}{石材|せきざい} — natural stone
- {石材|せきざい}の{種類|しゅるい} — types of stone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {石|いし} — stone, rock; the everyday general word
- {岩石|がんせき} — rock; a geological/scientific term for rock as a natural material
- {木材|もくざい} — lumber, wood; the parallel term for wood as a building material
- {建材|けんざい} — building material; a broader category that includes stone, wood, concrete, and other construction materials
